Chicken Breast With Jam
By: Bobbie Ventura
Published: Thursday, December 10, 2009 - 4:53pm

Ingredients




2 boneless chicken breast
salt to taste
pepper to taste
Blackberry Jam

Preparation

1 Rince and drychicken.  Salt and pepper ro taste. Bake un a 375 degree oven, each side for 10-15 min.  Spread jam over up side and bake til brown app. 5 min.  Turn and bake other side the same.  Remove and serve.

About


This is a quick low fat food.  you can substitute any jelly or jam for this to give you more variaty.
